candidate_trace_universe: all source rows in the frozen training interval that have an exact physical nodelist and an integer 1..4 source-derived GPU allocation per occupied node; only U2 membership is eligible for active flexible support
capacity_equation: G_n(t) = sum(source-derived per-node gpus_requested for all active candidate jobs on physical node n)
conflict_job_set: Q = union of every job active in every capacity-conflict interval
quarantine: every member of Q is excluded from active flexible power; Q members outside frozen U2 are recorded separately and already have no active flexible target
quarantined_power_role: whole-IT load and total-IT denominator retained; flexible delta not authorized; power remains in P_IT_REF residual
